evidence_quotes.quote: Evaluation of Sanitation Strategies and Initiatives Implemented in Mexico from Community Capitals Point of View
Received: 3 January 2019; Accepted: 19 January 2019; Published: 8 February 2019
This study aims to analyze both, previous and current sanitation strategies and initiatives that are implemented in Mexico.

rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible" for target record). The record metadata identifies Arjun Kumar (2015), "Rural Households' Access to Basic Amenities in India: Deprivation and Socio-economic Exclusions", whereas the retrieved PDF is a completely different paper: Thalía Turrén-Cruz, Juan Alejandro García-Rodríguez and Miguel Ángel López Zavala (2019), "Evaluation of Sanitation Strategies and Initiatives Implemented in Mexico from Community Capitals Point of View", Water 11(2), 295 (doi:10.3390/w11020295). Per screening instructions, when the retrieved PDF does not match the record metadata, the decision must be set to cannot_tell with exclusion_code NONE without guessing from the title.
